Enable this to negotiate Dolby Digital (: Enable this to negotiate Dolby Digital (DD) or Dolby Digital Plus (DD+) audio with the host instead of the default format. This feature allows you to send surround sound (5.1) through the TV's optical output, although it may also work over HDMI or other connections if your equipment is compatible. Dolby Digital audio uses less bandwidth than Opus, which GameStream-compatible hosts traditionally send by default. If the host does not provide the format, Moonlight will always fall back to Opus.
